title: Master SOP: offboarding of a senior employee, Lumina Retail NV, BE

steps.value: exit date = last working day, registered within 2 working days
steps.statement: Register the resignation within 2 working days, with the last working day as exit date.
Under the unified statute, an employee with 18 years of seniority who resigns works 13 weeks of notice.
The employer can waive the non-compete clause within 15 days after the exit date.
Pay departure holiday pay and, as the company CLA grants it, the pro-rata year-end bonus.

steps.value: car returned on last working day; BIK stops from the month after
steps.statement: The company car is returned on the last working day; the benefit-in-kind stops from the month after.

steps.value: notify insurer within 30 days of exit via employer portal
steps.statement: Notify the group insurance provider within 30 days of the exit via the employer portal.

steps.value: Dimona OUT by first working day after exit; C4 + holiday certificate on exit date
steps.statement: Declare Dimona OUT by the first working day after the exit; hand over C4 and holiday certificate on the exit date.

steps.value: structured handover session + written handover before the last working day
steps.statement: Capture the senior's know-how in a structured handover session and a written handover before the last working day.
